subject: CAIQ: cryptographic key proofs for OrbitalBank scope

From: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@orbitalbank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@orbitalbank.com
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ: cryptographic key proofs for OrbitalBank scope

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking this. Orbital Bank is validating a subset of CSA CAIQ controls around cryptography for the upcoming procurement window. Specifically we need evidence for: 

- Key management lifecycle (generation, rotation, decommission) mapped to CAIQ control CC-01a/CC-01b (or vendor equivalent)
- Proof that customer data keys are managed in a KMS/HSM and not exported in plaintext
- Evidence of key owner roles and separation of duties (who can rotate/revoke)
- Sample logs showing a rotation event and the associated audit trail

Can you provide a short intake that lists the artifacts you will produce, the owners for each artifact, and an expected delivery date? Also confirm whether Redwood can provide an HSM attestation (vendor cert) or if you will deliver a vendor-signed KMS attestation letter.

Attachments: key_rotation_log.csv (sample, redacted)

We'd like the consolidated package by 2027-03-25 if possible. If you need to break this into staged deliverables (logs first, attestations later) that works; please call out the cadence.

Best,
Alice Morgan
Head of Vendor Risk
Orbital Bank
alice.morgan@orbitalbank.com

4) Short mapping doc linking each artifact to the CAIQ control IDs you referenced 
   - will include recommended narrative text for your CAIQ response — owner: Jordan Blake — ETA: 2027-03-24

We can provide either an HSM vendor attestation (if we can surface our vendor cert) or a Redwood letter that references the vendor attestation and includes a summary of operational controls. Which format is preferred for your procurement team?

> Thanks for taking this. Orbital Bank is validating a subset of CSA CAIQ controls around cryptography for the upcoming procurement window.

Hi Alice — quick technical note: our customer-data encryption keys are envelope-encrypted with a customer key stored in a cloud KMS backed by an HSM (vendor-managed). Raw key material is never exported in plaintext.

I will prepare the following artifacts and redact any tenant-specific identifiers as requested:
- redacted_key_rotation_log.csv (rotation_id, timestamp, actor, key_alias) — sample rows included
- kms-access-report.txt (role list, last-used timestamps, IAM bindings)
- brief narrative on separation-of-duties and emergency rotation playbook (PDF)

ETA: I can upload the logs and access report to the Drive folder by 2027-03-20 EOD. For vendor attestation: we can provide the vendor certificate PDF if your team accepts vendor-signed certs. If you need a Redwood-signed attestation letter, Marissa — can you own that?

- Delivery: logs and access report by 2027-03-20; mapping + attestation by 2027-03-24. That meets the procurement timeline.
